content.comment_body: Please check the connection between your PC and the [product_name] module. For the [product_name] device: - Ensure it is powered on. - Confirm the transfer cable is properly connected between the [product_name] and your PC. - The device’s display should indicate ‘[product_name]<->PC’. How do I access the [product_name]<->PC mode on my [product_name] 230RC? My main menu options are: Program, Card, Setup, Start. Where can I find the '[product_name]<->PC' option? This is my first time using the module, and no program is loaded. Pressing ESC doesn’t help. Any assistance would be appreciated.
Hello [user_name], Perhaps this resource will be helpful: [url] Best regards, [user_name]
The issue was actually with the COM1 port on my notebook. I tried installing [product_name] programming software on a different PC, and everything is working fine now. Thank you! [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user had trouble connecting their PC to the [product_name] module and was unsure how to activate the connection mode via the device’s display menu. As a first-time user, the lack of guidance in the menu increased difficulty. Ultimately, the root cause was a problem with the COM1 port on their original notebook, and reinstalling the [product_name] software on another PC resolved the connectivity issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear, straightforward instructions for enabling PC-to-[product_name] connectivity, including easy-to-identify prompts or menu options, and clear feedback on connection status from the device display.
